decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building with the faces of the dormer windows tile hung to match the existing roof and the hip-to-gable extension finished in facing brick to match the materials used in existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (10A, 011A, 012A & 013A, received on 26/11/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof extensions to 6B and 6D Hounslow Road, Hanworth, Feltham, TW13 6QH hereby approved shall be completed as one building operation.
description: Erection of a hip to gable and a rear roof extensions with one front roof window to both flats
